title: Let them watch. 🔥
paragraphs: The hardest truth to accept is that some people are in your circle not to cheer you on, but to see how long you last before you break. They are waiting for your stumble.

But here is the Gospel truth: Their expectations do not determine your destination. When you walk with God, even the fire is just a pathway to His glory. Don’t give them the satisfaction of quitting. Keep your eyes fixed on the Light and keep walking.
📖 “Do not rejoice over me, my enemy; When I fall, I shall arise; When I sit in darkness, The Lord will be a light to me.” - Micah 7:8 (NKJV)
Are you walking through the fire right now? Drop a 🔥 if you refuse to give up!
